plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Persistent, encrypted memory for Claude Code. Deterministic capture via SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd hooks. Per-user HKDF-derived keys — vendor cannot decrypt your memory. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE end-to-end (0.3.1): 'anamnesis-config' runs the browser consent flow, hooks send Authorization: Bearer with automatic refresh rotation, legacy X-Anamnesis-Key kept as a fallback through the 2026-05-20 deprecation. Visible, searchable, deletable memory surface at anamnesis.smtry.ai.
